title: Wire ApplicationForm to /api/submit-form so submissions land in Registrations tab
description: Make the application form actually post submissions instead of being a no-op. Three core changes per the prior thread: (1) application-form.tsx — real onSubmit that POSTs JSON to /api/submit-form with kind=registration, plus submitting/success/error states; (2) /api/submit-form/route.ts — replace legacy registrationSchema with one matching the new application fields (gender, city, country, bio, directoryConsent, isSpeaker, essay1, essay2, reflection, etc.); (3) sheets-sink.ts — update REGISTRATION_COLUMNS to match. Plus tail-end fixes: (4) update /apply page banner that currently claims nothing is sent; (5) update Resend email template (currently 'You're registered for...' which is misleading for an application that hasn't been accepted); (6) update docs/setup-google-sheets.md with the new Registrations header row; (7) honeypot field on the form. File upload for speaker-doc is captured by filename only (real blob storage is a follow-up) — committee can email applicants for the file. Done when a submit on the local /apply or PROTOTYPE-toggled /register lands a row in the Registrations tab and the success card shows a real confirmation id.
close_reason: Application form now posts to /api/submit-form (kind=registration). E2E verified: SYN-UKM5-V5PMZF row landed in the Registrations tab. Schema replaced to match Dani-approved fields. REGISTRATION_COLUMNS rebuilt to match. Speaker upload captures filename only (real file storage is a follow-up). Email template updated from 'You're registered' to 'Application received'. /apply banner copy refreshed. Docs updated with new 22-col header row.
